title: A-B pair at separation 7, at rest: effective K_A(B) = 7.75 and K_B(A) = 10.97 at P = 2.5 (T <= 6)

claims.statement: One A and one B particle at rest, initial separation in [6.9, 7.1], duration at most 6: A accelerates toward B with magnitude K_A(B) / r^2.5 and B toward A with K_B(A) / r^2.5 (r the current separation), with K_A(B) = 7.75 and K_B(A) = 10.97 held constant. These are effective constants at P = 2.5 for this separation band; the claim makes no statement about other separations or the exponent. The ratio K_B(A)/K_A(B) = 1.41 matches the centre-of-mass stationarity expected for masses in ratio 1.41:1. Fitted to two lab-vernier runs (orientations horizontal and vertical, K fits agree to 0.5%). Out-of-sample error, fitting on one orientation and testing on the other, is 0.0050 to 0.0052 RMSE/L, at the tracker noise floor.
